basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Software Engineer, Containers · 9,300★ Open-Source Contributor · Go · Kubernetes · Docker · AWS/Azure · 3.5+ Years

summaries.barclays-containers: Backend Software Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience building containerized, cloud-native services in Go and Python, with hands-on Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/Azure experience. Diagnosed and resolved a production Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff incident and cut Azure cloud-governance resource-discovery latency 70–90% by migrating 35+ modules to event-driven architecture at Turbot HQ.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a cloud-native Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.
Migrated 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to push-based eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and eliminating recurring Azure API throttling.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline for Turbot Guardrails, where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced against a resource; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for manual investigation and debugging.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability/SIEM CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes to DuckDB; authored 11 AWS log-source tables (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, SecurityHub, VPC flow, WAF, and more) and 25+ pre-built security detections.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff, collaborating with the platform team to investigate pod logs and status and restore service.

Owned release engineering for four open-source Go CLIs (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) — unified GitHub Actions release/version workflows and GHCR Docker image tagging, and added multi-distro Linux smoke tests (CentOS, Ubuntu ARM64, macOS) to the release pipeline, hardening release safety across distributions.

work.name: Kredey (Kredey Innovations Pvt. Ltd.)
highlights: Used Elasticsearch to support full-text and semantic search over a NoSQL Firebase-backed document-sharing platform.
